% Pages of a PDF included with pdfpages, with a lastpage hint: every page,
% and a range to the last page. test/run.mjs also builds this page without
% shell escape, as with --contain, where the number of pages is not read
% and the hint gives it. With shell escape, the number read overrides the
% hint, as in test-pdfpages' run "lastpage". Each run starts with a
% paragraph "Run name."
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{pdfpages}
\begin{document}
Run dash.
\includepdf[pages=-,lastpage=4]{test-pdfpages/four}

Run last.
\includepdf[pages={2-last},lastpage=4]{test-pdfpages/four}

Run end.
\end{document}
